citations.passage:
Decision: each Wayfare display runs its own single-board computer with local
fallback rendering and no central station server — autonomy per display,

Context: after six weeks in the field, per-display autonomy shows its cost —
firmware drift across boards and roughly ninety minutes of manual reflash per
display when updates land (documented in s-004, reviewed in m-005).

judge.rationale: The answer correctly identifies the shift from one single-board computer per display to an edge-gateway hub per station and attributes it to field maintenance pain documented in s-004 and reviewed in m-005. However, it omits key supporting details: local fallback rendering, the six-week field period, firmware drift, roughly ninety-minute manual reflashes per display, and the resulting reduction in maintenance effort by the June ship retro.
